scope: Third layer: FV / assurance probes that validate or constrain production (FCO/CTCubFe) nodes. Not a roadmap; each node attaches to the production node it assures.

edge_kinds.hard: participates in topological sort (real implementation prerequisite)
edge_kinds.assures: FV experiment validates or constrains the target production node
edge_kinds.blocks_bad: FV result forbids an unsound design path on the target
edge_kinds.rearms: FV probe must be re-run when the target changes

status_roles.decision_receipt: answered once; now a recorded 'why we chose this'
status_roles.standing_harness: re-runnable; guards code that can change (pin + stale-detect)
status_roles.proto_proof_backend: research prototype that shapes a future compiler subsystem
status_roles.production_seed: matures into an actual compiler subsystem

FV0.title: assurance convention
FV0.description: Ledger + pinned reproducible harnesses, tied to commits, fail loudly when stale.

FV1.title: verbatim-vs-logical equivalence census
FV1.description: How often exact matching rejects logically-equivalent predicate pairs in the real corpus.

FV2.title: Form 3 VC census / z3
FV2.description: SMT census for quiet verification: guard-entailed VCs, encoding choices, check-premise requirements.

FV3.title: Merkle non-associativity counterexample
FV3.description: Machine-checked: keccak/Merkle combine is not associative -> no Monoid law.

FV4.title: Lean RPow Sized litmus
FV4.description: Lean litmus for Stage 2 RPow Sized proof.

FV5.title: AC1 normalization confluence
FV5.description: Ground assoc-const normalization has unique normal forms under fixed assumptions.

FV6.title: merge_runtime_class join probe
FV6.description: Bounded exec of real MIR runtime-class merge; latent non-join behavior, no current corpus reachability.

FV8.title: quote hygiene / no capture model
FV8.description: Quote elaboration + open-name validation; counterexamples become Fe fixtures.

FV9.title: Hash712 memory arithmetic model
FV9.description: Bounded/differential harness for Hash712 append arithmetic: contiguity, non-overlap, keccak range.

FV10.title: if/match expected-type divergence
FV10.description: Differential probe for if/else vs match expected-type threading; divergences become fixtures.

FV11.title: gate-vs-select coherence model
FV11.description: Counterexample backing gate-not-select and no predicate specialization.
